_doc: Card database. type: minion|spell. keywords: guard, swift, ward, drain, venom. effects[].on: play|death. Targets that start with 'choose_' are picked by the player; the rest resolve automatically. 'art' is the subject half of the image prompt (tools/cards/art_jobs.py adds the house style).

cards.name: Lost Pilgrim
cards.flavor: Midway through life, he woke in a dark wood.
cards.art: a weary medieval pilgrim in a torn hooded cloak gripping a wooden staff, lost in a dark twisted forest, lantern glow on his face

cards.name: Socrates, the Questioner
cards.flavor: He knows that he knows nothing, so he stands his ground.
cards.art: the old bearded philosopher Socrates in a white himation, calm and stubborn, one hand raised as if asking a question, marble columns of a ruined castle behind him

cards.name: Virtuous Pagan
cards.flavor: No sin, no torment. Only longing without hope.
cards.art: a dignified ancient Roman soul in a toga with a laurel wreath, standing in a pale green meadow of Limbo, melancholic expression, faint mist

cards.name: Horace, the Satirist
cards.flavor: His jokes still sting after two thousand years.
cards.art: the Roman poet Horace with a sly smirk, holding a sharp stylus like a dagger and a scroll, laurel wreath, warm candlelight

cards.name: Virgil's Counsel
cards.text: Draw a card. Restore 2 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: "Follow me, and I will be your guide."
cards.art: the ghost of the Roman poet Virgil in a crimson cloak and laurel crown, placing a reassuring hand on the shoulder of a frightened pilgrim, pointing ahead into darkness, soft golden light

cards.name: Ovid, the Exile
cards.flavor: Everything changes. Nothing truly dies.
cards.art: the Roman poet Ovid writing on a long scroll by candlelight, surrounded by swirling half-transformed figures of myth turning into trees and birds

cards.name: Lucan, the Chronicler
cards.text: On Play: Give a friendly minion +1/+1.
cards.flavor: He wrote the civil war. He knows what courage costs.
cards.art: the young Roman poet Lucan reading aloud a war epic from a scroll, armoured soldiers glowing behind him, heroic pose

cards.name: Light of Reason
cards.flavor: The one light that reaches Limbo.
cards.art: a blazing beam of golden light piercing the darkness of Hell and striking a shadowy demon, shards of shadow scattering

cards.name: The Seven Walls
cards.text: Give a friendly minion +1/+3 and Guard.
cards.flavor: A noble castle, ringed seven times by high walls.
cards.art: a noble castle with seven tall concentric walls and a stream around it, glowing with a warm inner light in the middle of eternal darkness

cards.name: Hector, Shield of Troy
cards.flavor: He fell defending his city. He still defends it.
cards.art: the Trojan prince Hector in bronze armour and a crested helmet, raising a great round shield, standing firm, embers flying

cards.name: Aeneas, the Founder
cards.flavor: From the ashes of Troy, he ran toward Rome.
cards.art: the Trojan hero Aeneas charging forward with sword drawn, cloak billowing, a burning city behind him

cards.name: Saladin, Alone Apart
cards.flavor: And he stood alone, set apart from the rest.
cards.art: the sultan Saladin in a white turban and gilded mail, scimitar lowered, standing alone and proud apart from a crowd of shades, calm noble face

cards.name: Homer, Sovereign Poet
cards.text: On Play: Give your other minions +1/+1.
cards.flavor: The lord of highest song, sword in hand.
cards.art: the blind ancient poet Homer, majestic white beard, holding a sword like a sceptre, leading a procession of poets, radiant halo of firelight

cards.name: Aristotle, Master of Those Who Know
cards.flavor: All the others look up to him.
cards.art: the philosopher Aristotle seated on a stone throne surrounded by admiring philosophers, holding an open codex, piercing wise gaze

cards.name: Banner Chaser
cards.flavor: They never chose a side. Now they chase a flag forever.
cards.art: a gaunt naked lost soul sprinting desperately after a whirling tattered banner in a dark storm, terrified face

cards.name: Worm-Fed Shade
cards.flavor: Their tears and blood feed the worms at their feet.
cards.art: a pale tormented sinner standing in mud with blood and tears running down, writhing pale worms at his feet

cards.name: Eager Soul
cards.flavor: Fear turns into longing on the shore of the river.
cards.art: a desperate damned soul reaching out from a dark riverbank toward the water, eyes wide, other shades crowding behind

cards.name: Oar Strike
cards.flavor: He beats with his oar whoever lingers.
cards.art: a huge wooden oar swinging down and smashing into a cowering soul, splash of black water and sparks

cards.name: The Great Refusal
cards.text: Return an enemy minion to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: He made the great refusal, out of cowardice.
cards.art: a hooded old pope turning his back and pushing away a golden papal tiara, walking into shadow, ashamed face

cards.name: Wasps and Hornets
cards.flavor: Stung forever, for they never stood for anything.
cards.art: a furious swarm of giant hellish wasps and hornets bursting out of darkness, glowing red stingers

cards.name: Wailing Damned
cards.text: On Play: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: Sighs, laments and loud wailing echoed through the starless air.
cards.art: a screaming damned soul with hands clutching its head, mouth wide open, shockwaves of sound rippling outward in the starless dark

cards.name: Mud-Drinker
cards.flavor: Thirst never ends on the bank of the Acheron.
cards.art: an emaciated grey shade kneeling on a muddy riverbank, drinking black water from cupped hands, red glowing eyes

cards.name: Gatekeeper Demon
cards.flavor: Abandon every hope, you who enter here.
cards.art: a horned muscular demon with bat wings guarding a massive dark stone gate with a carved arch, holding a spiked iron club

cards.name: Coal-Eyed Glare
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: Charon the demon, with eyes of burning coal.
cards.art: extreme close-up of the burning coal-red eyes of the ancient ferryman Charon, wild white eyebrows, wheels of fire around his eyes

cards.name: Shoreline Throng
cards.text: On Play: Summon two 1/1 Lost Souls.
cards.flavor: Like autumn leaves, they fall one after another.
cards.art: a dense crowd of naked damned souls pressing together on a dark riverbank, falling like autumn leaves toward the water

cards.name: The Earthquake
cards.flavor: The dark land shook, and a crimson light flashed.
cards.art: the ground of Hell splitting open in a violent earthquake, crimson lightning flashing across a dark sky, souls falling into the cracks

cards.name: Minos, Judge of the Damned
cards.text: On Play: Destroy a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He wraps his tail around himself once for every circle of the fall.
cards.art: Minos, the monstrous horned judge of Hell, seated on a dark throne, his long serpent tail coiled around his body, snarling, judging a trembling soul

cards.name: Hornet
cards.art: a single giant hellish hornet with glowing red stinger and veined wings, hovering

cards.name: Maggot
cards.art: a fat pale grotesque maggot writhing in dark blood-soaked mud

cards.name: Lost Soul
cards.art: a faint translucent naked ghostly soul curled up, drifting in the dark

heroes.name: Dante, the Pilgrim
heroes.art: portrait of the poet Dante Alighieri in a red hooded robe and laurel wreath, stern determined profile, lit by hellfire

heroes.name: Charon, the Ferryman

power.name: Ferry Toll
power.text: Deal 1 damage to the enemy hero.

heroes.art: portrait of Charon the ancient ferryman of Hell, white wild beard, eyes like burning coals, gripping a long oar, hooded
